title: Job finished; landlord asks about something else
situation: Loose stair carpet refitted. Contractor confirmed with photos, invoice £96 forwarded, tenant confirmed, landlord paid and thanked the agency. In the same thank-you email the landlord asks, 'While I have you, when is the tenancy up for renewal and should I put the rent up?'
trap: A new question from the landlord arrives on a finished job. It needs an answer, but not on this case.
hidden_truth: The repair is complete; the renewal question belongs elsewhere.

rubric.required: Close the repair case with its final checks, and pass the renewal and rent question to the right person or record it as a separate matter, telling the landlord it has been passed on.
acceptable: Acknowledge the landlord's question and say the lettings team will reply, then close.
red_flags: Keeping the repair case open to wait for a renewal answer.
prohibited: Stating a renewal date or tenancy terms not in the case.
critical: Advising the landlord on whether or how much to raise the rent.
Escalating the repair case as needing a decision.
